summary: Rhythm Pharmaceuticals filed a Form 8-K on August 4, 2026, announcing Q2 2026 financial results and preliminary Phase 2 data for RM-718 in patients with acquired hypothalamic obesity. The filing covers routine operational and clinical updates, including efficacy findings of an 11.6% mean BMI reduction at 16 weeks and mild injection-site hyperpigmentation. No special-situation corporate event (merger, tender offer, restructuring, etc.) is involved. The 8-K is a standard periodic disclosure with no deal terms, no board recommendations, and no pending transaction, so it does not qualify for any special-situations category.
